From Milagroman · Price: the target must accept your money.

Theme Fate

  • 1: 1 action: hand over a coin; a creature that accepts it is cursed (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will} negates): –1 to checks for 1 round.
  • 5: Surge: the money multiplies; the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} from the weight.
  • 9: The curse lasts 1 minute.
  • 13: The curse spreads to anyone the creature passes money to.
  • 17: Enfeebled 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{slowed 1}.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.shPERG1fHjbv9DyF]{Effect: Cursed Wealth}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
